name: n4_export_history
description: Export a range of one or more histories to ONE CSV file for client reports (station-audits S2). history_ids lists 1 to 20 ids, each checked like n4_read_history's history_id (/<station>/<history name>, or a bare history name of the connected station; anything else, '..', quotes and '|' included, is refused before any request). Optional range: period (today, last24Hours, yesterday, weekToDate, lastWeek, last7Days, monthToDate, lastMonth, yearToDate, lastYear) or start and/or end (BAbsTime or a span back from now such as 30m, 24h, 7d), not both; no range is the whole history. Each history is one read of select timestamp.encodeToString, value.encodeToString, status (machine-encoded: timestamp ISO-8601 with the station's offset, value 21.0 not '21,0'); the newest max_rows records of each (default 100000) are written oldest first. The server names and places the file: <state-dir>/exports/<station>-<UTC time>.csv (directory 0700, file 0600, never overwritten; the caller never passes a path). Columns: history_id,timestamp,value,status (header first, CSV quoting where a cell holds a comma, quote or newline, lines end in CRLF). Reply: path, rows_total, per_history [{history_id, rows, truncated}] (truncated: the range held more than max_rows records), bytes. A history that cannot be read stops the export with an error naming it, and no file is left. Reads the station only; the one write is that local file.

history_ids.description: 1 to 20 history ids, e.g. ["/MyStation/Temp", "Humidity"] (a bare name is a history of the connected station)

period.description: Period id: today, last24Hours, yesterday, weekToDate, lastWeek, last7Days, monthToDate, lastMonth, yearToDate or lastYear

start.description: Range start as a BAbsTime, e.g. 2026-11-15T00:00:00.000-06:00, or a span back from now: 30m, 24h, 7d

end.description: Range end as a BAbsTime, or a span back from now: 30m, 24h, 7d

max_rows.description: Most records written per history (the newest of the range)

timeout_s.description: HTTP timeout per request in seconds
